title: Protocol for generation and assessment of head-like structure in zebrafish
protocol: Dechorionate zebrafish embryos by pronase treatment in 0.3× Danieau buffer for 1-2 minutes.
Place dechorionated zebrafish embryos on an agarose-coated plate with 0.3× Danieau buffer.
Inject ndr2 mRNA (10 pg) mixed with dextran-fluorescein or dextran-rhodamine B into one animal pole blastomere of the zebrafish embryo at the 128-cell stage.
Cut off the animal pole explants from the zebrafish embryos.
Generate needles by using a needle puller with appropriate parameters for extra long tapers as previously reported.
Cut off the animal pole region (1/3–1/2) of the embryo using a syringe needle at the 1k-cell stage.
Culture the animal pole explants in an agarose-coated plate (2% agarose) with zebrafish cell culture medium at 29°C until harvest.
Prepare the cell washing solution and cell resuspended solution.
Dissociate the explants into single cells by dissociation reagent (TrypLE Select).
Centrifuge the dissociated cells at 200 g, 4°C, for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant, and then resuspend the cells by cell washing solution.
Centrifuge the dissociated cells at 200 g, 4°C, for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with cell resuspension solution.
Count the cell number.
Assess cell viability by Trypan blue staining and Propidium iodide (PI) staining.
Construct cDNA libraries using the Chromium Controller and Chromium Single Cell 3′ Library & Gel Bead Kit per the manufacturer’s protocol.
Sequence the libraries with Illumina NovaSeq using paired-end at 150 bp read length.
Pre-coat 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes with 10% BSA/PBS for 15 minutes at 20°C–25°C before transferring explants.
Pre-process bulk RNA-seq data.
Align reads from Fastq files to the Danio rerio reference transcriptome Ensembl Release 92 using the STAR function.
Sort aligned reads using the samtools sort function.
Assign aligned reads to each gene using the featureCounts function, generating gene counts for each sample.
Construct DESeqDataSet object for differential expression analysis.
Read in gene count files of each sample using the read.table function.
Merge gene counts using the multimerge function to create a count matrix.
Construct metadata with sample names and conditions by merging time and treatment data.
Create a DESeqDataSet object using the DESeqDataSetFromMatrix function with the count matrix and metadata as inputs, setting the condition column as design.
Perform differential expression analysis on the DESeqDataSet object using the results function, specifying appropriate contrasts for group comparisons.
Compare Nodal explants to wild-type explants at each time point.
Compare CHX-treated Nodal explants to wild-type explants at each time point.
Use a p-value <0.05 and absolute log2FC ≥ 1 as thresholds to identify differentially expressed genes.
Treat embryos with 50 μg/mL CHX after 20 minutes of Nodal injection to generate CHX-treated Nodal explants.
Note: This protocol focuses on identifying targets downstream of Nodal signaling; other manipulations can be applied for investigating signals from other molecules.
Select overlapped DE genes in Nodal explants and CHX-treated Nodal explants at each time point.
Generate three overlapped DE gene sets.
Define common genes in the three overlapped DE gene sets as Nodal targets.
Cluster downstream targets into four clusters using the kmeans function.
Scale the expression of downstream targets (105 Nodal targets) using the scale function.
Perform Gene ontology (GO) enrichment analysis on each gene cluster using the enrichGO function.
Calculate mean of scaled gene expression in each cluster using the mean function.

Use Pearson method to calculate correlation coefficients between scaled expression mean of each cluster and treatment concentration/duration time using the cor.test function with p-values calculated by Student’s t test.
Perform a heatmap showing correlations between downstream target clusters and treatment concentration/duration time using the pheatmap::pheatmap function.
Align sequencing reads in FASTQ files to the reference (Danio rerio reference transcriptome Ensembl Release 92) using cellranger count function.
Generate output used for Seurat from the alignment step.
Read in the output of the cellranger pipeline using the Read10x function.
Create a Seurat object using the count matrix obtained from Read10x function.
Check the level of unique feature counts, total molecule counts and mitochondrial counts.
Filter out low-quality cells using the FilterCells function.
Normalize data using the NormalizeData function with default settings ("LogNormalize" method with a scale factor as 10,000).
Identify highly variable features using the FindVariableFeatures function.
Scale the data using the ScaleData Function with regression of nUMI and mitochondrial genes.
Perform PCA on scaled data using the RunPCA function with identified variable features as input.
Construct a KNN graph using the FindNeighbors function with the defined dimensionality as input.
Cluster cells using the FindClusters function with a resolution ranging from 0.5 to 2.
Run non-linear dimensional reduction using the RunUMAP function with the defined dimensionality.
Visualize the dataset using the DimPlot function with UMAP as reduction.
Identify top marker genes of each cluster using the FindMarkers function.
Annotate each cluster based on the expression of cellular markers.
Prepare decolorization solution by mixing 30% H2O2 and 5% KOH in a volume ratio of 1:9.
Remove fixative from explants or embryos older than 24 hpf.
Place the treated explants or embryos into a plastic culture dish.
Add 2-3 mL of decolorization solution to the culture dish.
Observe under microscope until pigment on embryos' eyes disappears.
Remove decolorization solution after pigment disappearance.
Wash with 25%, 50%, 75% and 100% methanol/PBS for 5 min each at 20°C–25°C.
Store decolorized embryos or explants in 100% methanol at -20°C.
Rehydrate the stored explants by washing through 75%, 50% and 25% methanol/PBST for 5 min each.
Wash three times with PBST for 5 min each.
Add Proteinase K to PBST to prepare a digestion solution with a final concentration of 10 μg/mL.
Treat explants or embryos with the digestion solution at 20°C–25°C for the appropriate time based on their developmental stage.
Remove the digestion solution and add 1 mL of 4% PFA for refixation.
Leave the sample in 4% PFA at 20°C–25°C for 20 minutes.
Wash the sample four times with PBST at 20°C–25°C, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Pipette 300 μL of preheated HM solution into an EP tube containing the explants or embryos from the previous steps.
Incubate the mixture at 70°C for 3–5 hours.
Use a vacuum pump to remove the solution from the EP tube.
Add 300 μL of HM solution containing 2 ng/μL probe to the tube.
Hybridize the sample with the probe-containing solution in a hybridization oven at 70°C for 12–16 hours.
Reheat HM solution containing the probe at 70°C for 30 minutes.
Recycle hybridization solution containing the probe and store it in a -20°C freezer.
Wash residual hybridization solution with HM solution at 70°C.
Wash through 75%, 50%, and 25% HM/2× SSC solutions at 70°C for 15–20 minutes each.
Wash once with 2× SSC at 70°C for 15–20 minutes.
Wash twice with 0.2× SSC at 70°C for 30–40 minutes each.
Gradually transition to PBST buffer by washing through 75%, 50%, and 25% 0.2xSSC/PBST solutions at 20°C-25°C for 15–20 minutes each.
Wash once with PBST at 20°C-25°C for 15–20 minutes.
Remove PBST, add 1 mL of Incubation Mix, and incubate on a low-speed shaker at 20°C-25°C for 3–5 hours.
Remove the Incubation Mix, add 1 mL of Incubation Mix containing 0.1 μL/mL DIG AP (anti-DIG antibody).
Incubate for 12 h–16 h at 4°C on a low-speed shaker.
Transfer the explants or embryos to an experimental bench at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the antibody incubation solution.
Wash once with PBST quickly.
Wash with PBST six times at 20°C–25°C for 15 min each time.
Remove the PBST.
Add 1 mL of freshly prepared Alkaline Tris (AT) Buffer.
Wash with AT Buffer three times on a low-speed shaker at 20°C–25°C, each for 5 min.
Transfer the explants or embryos in the EP tube to the six-well plate.
Remove the AT Buffer.
Add 2 mL of labeling solution to the wells.
Transfer the six-well plate to a dark place.
Observe the labeling under a microscope every 15–30 min.
Remove the labeling solution.
Wash quickly with PBST.
Wash three times with PBST at 20°C–25°C for 5 min each time.
Add glycerol and transfer to a 4°C refrigerator for storage (not performed for double-color in situ hybridization).
Use a stereomicroscope to photograph and record the results of in situ hybridization from different angles and positions.
Treat with 0.1 M glycine-HCl (pH 2.2, 0.1% Tween 20) at 20°C–25°C for 10 min.
Wash with PBST at 20°C–25°C four times, 5 min each time.
Remove the PBST, add Incubation Mix and transfer to a low-speed shaker at 20°C–25°C for 5 h.
Block and incubate with antibody.
Add fluorescein-labeled antibody at a ratio of 1:2000 in the Incubation Mix.
Remove the Incubation Mix, add the Incubation Mix containing the antibody.
Transfer to a low-speed shaker in a 4°C refrigerator for 12 h–16 h.
Remove the incubation solution.
Wash quickly with PBST at 20°C–25°C once.
Wash six times with PBST at 20°C–25°C, 15 min each time (on a low-speed shaker).
Remove the PBST, add 1 mL of pH 8.2, 1 M Tris-HCl.
Wash three times on a low-speed shaker at 20°C–25°C for 5 min each time.
Remove Tris-HCl and add labeling solution.
Wash once with PBST after staining regions.
Wash three times with PBST for 5 minutes each time (on a low-speed shaker).
Add glycerol after washing.
Store in a refrigerator at 4°C for later use.
Incubate explants without agitation when exchanging solutions.
Collect 30–40 explants at the required time points into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Discard extra culture media as much as possible.
Add 1 mL of 4% PFA to the tube and store at 4°C for at least 16 hours but no more than 24 hours.
Wash explants with 1 mL of 1× PBST three times, each for 10 minutes.
Wash explants with 1 mL of 100% methanol twice, each for 10 minutes.
Store explants at -20°C for at least 2 hours before use.
Rehydrate the explant with a series of MeOH/PBST: 75% MeOH/25% 1× PBST, then 50% MeOH/50% 1× PBST, and finally 25% MeOH/75% 1× PBST, each for 10 minutes.
Wash explants with 1 mL of 100% 1× PBST three times, each for 10 minutes.
Incubate with 10 μg/mL Proteinase K at 20°C–25°C for 1 minute.
Fix explants with 4% PFA for 10 minutes.
Wash explants with 1× PBST four times, each for 10 minutes.
Pre-warm the probe hybridization buffer to 37°C.
Transfer 30–40 explants to a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube.
Rinse explants with 100 μL of probe hybridization buffer.
Discard excess probe hybridization buffer.
Add 100 μL probe hybridization buffer to the sample.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Prepare probe hybridization buffer by adding 0.4 μL of probe stock (1 μM) to 100 μL probe hybridization buffer.
Pre-warm the prepared probe hybridization buffer to 37°C.
Incubate explants with 100 μL pre-warmed probe hybridization buffer at 37°C for 12 h–16 h.
Stop the hybridization by repeated washing.
Carefully remove the hybridization buffer from the samples.
Wash the samples 4 times, each time with 100 μL of pre-warmed probe buffer for 20 minutes at 37°C.
Pre-amplify the samples with 200 μL of probe amplification buffer at 20°C–25°C for 30 minutes.
Prepare hairpin solution by transferring 2 μL each of hairpin h1 and hairpin h2 to separate centrifuge tubes.
Snap cool the hairpins by heat at 95°C for 90 seconds, then cool in the dark for 30 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Add snap cooled hairpins to 100 μL amplification buffer.
Incubate explants with 100 μL of hairpin solution at 20°C–25°C in the dark until appropriate fluorescent signals are gained.
Stop amplification by using 5× SSC 0.001% tween-20 to wash several times at 20°C–25°C.
Inject mRNA into one random blastomere at the margin of the 32-cell stage zebrafish embryos.
Inject approximately 4 pL of a mixture containing mRNA and fluorescent dye.
Select embryos with fluorescent signal on the ventral side at shield stage using a fluorescence stereoscopic microscope.
Transfer selected embryos to a new culture plate.
Photograph the selected embryos.
Fix the embryos for 12 h–16 h in 4% PFA at either 12 or 24 hours post-fertilization (hpf).
Perform whole-mount in situ hybridization (WISH) of six3b, egr2b, shha, pax2a and cdx4 for the fixed embryos.
Photograph the embryos.
Analyze the WISH results.
